findings.detail: Commentary is a single sentence run-on followed by two more, but the third sentence contains a semicolon joining two independent clauses, effectively creating clause-stuffing. The piece also runs long at ~3 dense sentences with multiple sub-clauses each, pushing toward a wall of text.
findings.fixable: Split the third sentence at the semicolon into two separate sentences to comply with 'one declarative claim per sentence'.

findings.detail: The phrase 'will follow HY if' is a forward-looking conditional stated as our own forecast with no institutional attribution (no Goldman, Fed, or named source cited). [critic downgraded]
findings.fixable: Replace 'will follow HY if' with an attributed framing, e.g. 'Goldman credit strategy flags IG as vulnerable to contagion should labor deterioration accelerate and earnings guidance weaken.'

findings.detail: The numeric '61bp' and '340bp' and '89bp' must be verified against the corresponding KPI tiles and raw data within the same render cycle. No data was supplied to confirm these figures; factual grounding is assumed but unverified.
'tends to be' is mild hedging filler that softens a declarative claim without adding analytical value.
findings.fixable: Replace 'tends to be self-reinforcing' with 'is self-reinforcing' or cite a sourced mechanism.
